1 · Intro

When to use it.

Most hires need a background check before they can start. For staff on a requisition, it runs through recruiting automatically. Your part is setting it up correctly on the requisition and waiting for clearance before you convert.

Use this whenYou're hiring someone and need to know when they're cleared to start.

HCM Academy job aid · Hiring

Background checks

Use when: You're hiring someone and need to know when they're cleared to start. · System: Process

  1. Set it up on the requisition.
  2. New York has its own order.
  3. The recruiter picks the packages at the offer.
  4. PEBC clears the candidate.
  5. Then convert the pending worker.
  6. Not on a requisition? Request it manually.

Watch-outs

  • Work with minors = Yes adds a protection of minors check.
  • Not sure where a candidate stands? Ask central recruiting before you create a direct hire.
